name: Kamishiro Sakuya
source:
Kaoru's classmate and a friend of Mizuki. A stylish girl who gets good grades and is good at sports. When she's not working as a Shrine Maiden at her family's Shinto Shrine, she practices her swordfighting technique.

[Edited from [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Yin-Yang!_X-Change_Alternative]Wikipedia[/url] and game manual]
